jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
jobs.description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. Youâll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If youâre a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team! This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptalâs perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs. Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptalâs vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest. Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success. Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team. Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics. In the first week, expect to: Onboard and integrate into Toptal. Learn Toptalâs model, our value proposition, and our story. Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success. Learn the breadth of Toptalâs impact on the worldâs largest companies. Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal. Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success. In the first month, expect to: Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios. Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator). Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts. Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives. Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers. In the first three months, expect to: Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities. Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal. Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives. Become proficient in using our SaaS tools. Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com. In the first six months, expect to: Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives. Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs. Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptalâs partnerships, and continue to execute account plans. Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities. In the first year, expect to: Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list. Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelorâs degree is required. 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR. Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients. Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal. Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries. Conscientiousness. Weâre not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important. Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement. Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business. Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative. Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies. Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts. Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures. Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks. Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process. You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path. You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings. Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise. Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend. Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM. Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests. Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor. Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation. Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical. Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team. In the first week, expect to: Onboard and integrate into Toptal. Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story. Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method. Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business. Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed. In the first month, expect to: Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios. Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment. Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities. Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. In the first three months, expect to: Be fully ramped and integrated into the team. Complete additional vertical-specific training. Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets. Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel. In the first six months, expect to: Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets. Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work. Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures. In the first year, expect to: Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies. Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients. Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio. Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team. Required Qualifications 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role). Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close. Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Full availability during your working hours to take client calls. Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines. Exceptional time management is key to success in this role. Preferred Qualifications Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience. Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar. Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account. Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts. Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows. Core Competencies Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch. Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing. Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve. Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal. Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer. Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it. Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team. Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win. jobs.title: Danish Speaking Solutions Consultant Work Sofia Bulgaria
jobs.description: Danish Speaking Solutions Consultant About Mercier Consultancy Group Mercier Consultancy Group is a premier international staffing firm, recognized for bridging the gap between high-caliber talent and global industry leaders. We pride ourselves on delivering bespoke recruitment solutions that empower professionals to excel in the competitive Customer Support Services landscape while advancing their international careers. Job Overview We are currently sourcing exceptional talent for a Danish Speaking Solutions Consultant position in Bulgaria. This role is a fantastic opportunity to join a world-class team in the Customer Support Services sector, where your linguistic expertise will directly influence client satisfaction and service delivery in one of the most exciting jobs in Bulgaria. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary point of contact for Danish-speaking customers, providing high-level technical and administrative support. Resolve complex inquiries through multiple channels, maintaining the high standards expected in the Customer Support Services industry. Document all interactions accurately within the CRM to ensure a seamless service experience for every client. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description: About KIRA Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone. Â In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Â Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading. Â These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges. Â The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. Â We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted. Â What You'll Own Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery. Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability. Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience. Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing. Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling. Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners. Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements. Â What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production. Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems. Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs. Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain. Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints. Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used. Â Nice to have Engineering or highly technical product background. Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products. Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products. Â Outcome Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction Location This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Technical interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life. Â Role As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work. Â What You'll Own Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets. Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets. Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications. Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows. Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices. Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly. Â What We're Looking For Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces. Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details. Able to independently own features from technical design through production. Â Outcomes Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows. Â Tech Stack TypeScript React.js / Next.js HTML / CSS WebSockets / streaming APIs Node.js REST / GraphQL APIs Â How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product. Â Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally. jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description: About Magic Eden and Dicey Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets. We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up. The role Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own. This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer. What you'll do Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable What we're looking for Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others Comfortable with ambiguity. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life. Â Role As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work. Â What You'll Own Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets. Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets. Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications. Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows. Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices. Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly. Â What We're Looking For Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces. Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details. Able to independently own features from technical design through production. Â Outcomes Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows. Â Tech Stack TypeScript React.js / Next.js HTML / CSS WebSockets / streaming APIs Node.js REST / GraphQL APIs Â How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product. Â Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally. jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. Position SummaryÂ The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration & Commissioning (SI&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â Key ResponsibilitiesÂ On-Site DeliveryÂ Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI&C team.Â Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â Remote / Office DeliveryÂ Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â Project Configuration & DeploymentÂ Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack & Hold).Â Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â Scope & IndependenceÂ This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â Preferred QualificationsÂ Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â What we Offer: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Health Care Concierge Service 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax & Roth) Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Long-Term Disability Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity Insurance Pet Insurance Milk Stork Program Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & 10 Holidays) Training & Development Why KPI Solutions? At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. KPI Solutions provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by states, federal, or local law. jobs.title: VP Pricing & Packaging
jobs.description: About Delinea: Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube . Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you. Â Apply today to help us achieve our mission. Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. What You Will Own Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling. Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure. Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it. Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing. Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product. The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement. Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data. What We Are Looking For 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function. A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench. Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body. Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization). Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance. Strongly preferred Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management. Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription. Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus. Why Now Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it. Why work at Delinea? We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities. We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative. What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression. At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success: Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team Ownership - We take initiative and follow through Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie. We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays. Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed. jobs.description: We are hiring aÂ contract-based Senior Shopify Developer Â to contribute to our Design and Development Team. Original Job posting link here ð About garden3d We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions. Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian. Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space. We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs. Sanctuary Computer Â â Development At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson. Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development. XXIX Â â Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be. Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility. Plus, our partner organizations Lightphone Mill IngredientAI ð®Â Who weâre looking for: We're looking for aÂ Senior Shopify Developer Â who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences. In this role, youâll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include: Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs. Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js). Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design. Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs. Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages. Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms. Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance. Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives. The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations. We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have! ðÂ Must-Have Competencies: Weâre always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us! 8+ years Â writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals. Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Â Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using theÂ Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) Â and frameworks likeÂ Hydrogen/Remix Â orÂ Next.js . Modern Frontend Tech: Â Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion). Headless CMS & Integrations: Â Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe). Platform & Hosting: Â Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen. Architecture & State Management: Â Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows. Quality & Accessibility: Â Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code. Performance Optimization: Â Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks. ðªÂ Nice-to-Have Competencies: Custom App Development: Â Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI. Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Â Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations. Tracking & Analytics: Â Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times. WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Â Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``. Full-Stack & API Design: Â Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT). Client-Facing & Management: Â Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams. ð¸Â Compensation Our pay scale ranges fromÂ $40/hr Â toÂ $120/hr Â pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week. We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements. ð¤Â How we interview After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests. From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business. For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow. ð©âð­Â How we work: We believe that thereâs a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops: Transparency & Ownership : Â We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. Weâre proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community. 150% Carbon Negative : Â Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same.Â We have been certified climate neutral since 2021. Strong Morals: Â Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative). Async & Decentralized: Â We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time. Remote Friendly: Â Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process. Ideas & Products: Â In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio? â Read more on our Substack,Â over here , or our Medium,Â over there . Important Reminders Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process. Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :) Please mention the word **GLISTENING** and tag RMjgwMDoyMjgyOjEwNDA6YTRhZTpmOTFhOjdmYTg6MmY1Mzo5ZGIy when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjgwMDoyMjgyOjEwNDA6YTRhZTpmOTFhOjdmYTg6MmY1Mzo5ZGIy). Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be! The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market. This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic. jobs.title: Junior Payroll Assistant
jobs.description: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs. We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space. We operate across 3 business segments: Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific. Mission of the role To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines. The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation. Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls. Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month. Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission. Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements. Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy. Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries. Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day. Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required. Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues. Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times. Must-have experience Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience. Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred. Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage. Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes. Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage. Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics. Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows. Must-have attributes Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks. Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required. Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements. Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients. Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship. AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective. Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles: We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles: Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us. Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence. Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers. Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue. Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business. The interview process The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish. TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background. Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines. Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations. Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages. Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify: Your education Any criminal history Any political exposure Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com. Some other great things about working at Sleekâ¦ Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.Â Flexibility: Youâll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we donât mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region. Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Thereâs also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. Weâre also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional. Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Â Since we started our journey in 2017, weâve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, weâve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific. Mission of the role To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines. The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation. Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls. Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month. Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission. Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements. Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy. Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries. Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day. Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required. Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues. Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times. Must-have experience Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience. Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred. Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage. Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes. Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage. Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics. Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows. Must-have attributes Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks. Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required. Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements. Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients. Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship. AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us. Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence. Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers. Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue. Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language.
