jobs.description: About the role The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company. About Arabian Private Holdings Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets. What you will do Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment. Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations. Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies. Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals. Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates. Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized. Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews. Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports. What we are looking for A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving. Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors. Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English. Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors. Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review. A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics. How we work We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients. What the role offers A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market. Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates. Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region. The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote. Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wingâs fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us. About the Role: Wing is looking for a Regional Flight Operations Support Manager to join our Flight Operations team. This role is based remotely in the United States . What Youâll Do: People Leadership & Development: Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of Flight Operations Support Coordinators. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and deliver actionable feedback to raise the bar for team performance. Oversee Regional Vendor Strategy: Serve as the primary regional point of contact for Vendor leadership to manage contract adherence and optimize the deployment of Ground Support and Visual Observer crews. Operational Systems Governance: Oversee regional utilization of workforce management tools (e.g., Deputy, ServiceNow) and Google Workspace (gSuite), ensuring the team maintains high standards for data integrity and consistent application of scheduling protocols. Financial & Administrative Oversight: Function as the primary approver for team timesheets, expense reports, and regional travel. Simplify complex regional budget issues into actionable steps to solve problems alongside peer managers. Long-Range Capacity Planning: Forecast regional staffing requirements based on projected flight volumes, partnering with internal stakeholders to proactively adjust vendor headcount and recruitment pipelines. SOP Development & Training: Lead the creation and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for site logistics and crew readiness; ensure consistent "Wing Standards" and health and safety policy compliance across the region. Cross-Functional Integration: Actively connect your team with cross-functional partners (Maintenance, Training, Community Affairs) to promote shared goals and enable effective teamwork toward Wingâs most important targets. Represent Wing by engaging with public and government visitors to support regional outreach activities. What Youâll Need: 5+ years of experience in aviation operations, logistics, or workforce management, including proven experience as a people manager leading distributed teams. Valid Driver's License Demonstrated Leadership: Proven ability to set priorities, provide coaching, and manage the performance of direct reports in high-pressure environments. Strategic Problem Solving: Ability to independently manage project planning and solve problems of moderate complexity with high ambiguity. Scheduling Flexibility: Willing and able to work 5 days/week, including weekends and/or holidays as business needs dictate. Operational Expertise: 2+ years of direct experience in Commercial Drone operations (Part 107/135). Active 14 CFR Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate required. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency. Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs. Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems. Strong organizational and time management skills. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with CRM or ERP software. Familiarity with database management systems. Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices. Competitive salary. Flexible working schedule where applicable. Paid time off and company holidays. Opportunities for professional development and career growth. Supportive and collaborative team culture. Ongoing training and skill development. Performance recognition and advancement opportunities. Access to modern digital collaboration tools. jobs.description: Type: Full time Salary: Location-dependent (UK: Â£30,000âÂ£35,000 GBP / Canada: CAD $48,000â$57,000) + share options Location: UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only) Meet The Guru Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track. We boost efficiency, improve resource utilisation, and increase project profitability - while promoting a healthy work/life balance. Weâre proud to be one of the leaders in our category, trusted by customers in over 100 countries - including top creative agencies like Publicis, TBWA, Grey, BBH, and M&C Saatchi, as well as household names like NASA, Accenture, CNN, Kraft Heinz, and the NHS. They rely on Resource Guru to manage one of their most valuable assets - their peopleâs time. Weâre a small, fully remote team based across the UK and Europe. We collaborate mainly via Slack, with occasional meetups to connect, plan, and celebrate. See if this is the right place for you. â­ï¸ The role Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team. As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support. This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru. Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets. This is a great role for someone with some experience in SaaS or online customer support who wants to keep developing their technical, communication and customer-facing skills in a friendly, remote-first team. What Youâll Be Doing Learning Resource Guru inside out In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer. Responding to customer questions Help customers with day-to-day support questions, including product usage, account setup, billing enquiries, troubleshooting and general "how do Iâ¦?" queries. Most support is handled by email, though you may occasionally join a phone or video call when that would help resolve something more quickly. Troubleshooting problems Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes. Working with the wider team Work closely with Dana and the wider Resource Guru team to understand customer questions, resolve issues, and make sure useful feedback is shared with Product and Engineering. Help create clear internal reports when customers report bugs or technical issues, and tag/categorise feature feedback so the team understands what customers need. Improving our help content Help keep the Help Centre useful and up to date - updating existing articles, writing new ones, recording simple walkthroughs, or suggesting improvements when you notice customers asking the same questions repeatedly. Using our support tools Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly. Helping customers feel looked after A big part of this role is making sure customers feel heard, understood and helped. We care about support that is accurate and efficient, but also warm, human and thoughtful. Bonus (not required) It would be a bonus if you have experience with any of the following: Supporting a SaaS product Helping customers with billing, subscriptions or invoices Writing Help Centre articles or customer-facing guides Using support tools such as Front, Intercom, Zendesk, HubSpot or similar Working in a fully remote team Recording short customer help videos or walkthroughs Supporting customers across multiple time zones, especially APAC-friendly hours Comfortable using AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work Working Hours This is a remote role, for people based in either the UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only). Youâll also need regular overlap with the UK team for training, collaboration and handovers. The exact working pattern will depend on your location and the coverage we agree, but you should be clear in your application about where youâre based and what working hours you would expect to keep. â Our Hiring Process Meet with Imogen (Talent/People Ops): 25-30m video call. Imogen will tell you a bit more about what itâs like to be on Team Guru. Please come prepared with any questions about our ways of working or team structure. Dana will talk with you about your previous support experience, your communication style, your technical troubleshooting skills, and any experience you have with billing or invoice-related enquiries. Meet with Percy (cofounder): 30m video call. This will follow a typical interview format with an opportunity for you to ask questions and learn more about the role. If you are unsure whether you meet the qualifications for this role but are still interested, we encourage you to apply. About the Role BMWL is seeking a freelance Creative Director to support branding and media development across our client roster. This is a flexible, project-based engagement ideal for a seasoned creative who thrives working with campaigns, advocacy groups, and public affairs clients. Our team consists of around 350 creative professionals from 36 countries, with 2 offices in Vilnius, Lithuania. Spike, the global animated series, is searching for talented voice actors to bring its characters to life! Our YouTube channel has reached over 1 billion views, entertaining children worldwide with universal, character-driven stories. We're casting our two lead roles: Spike, an imaginative, curious, and fearless 7-year-old whose creativity turns everyday moments into adventures; and Sparkle, his confident, attention-loving 5Â½-year-old sister with unmistakable main-character energy. Plus, there are loving parents, friends, foes, and all the colorful citizens that make Spike's world so vibrant. jobs.title: Regional General Manager Airports
jobs.description: Why WestJet Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success. Join us, this is where your career story takes off. This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program. Regional General Manager, Airports As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region. This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience. The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience. Key Deliverables Include Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results. Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities. Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans. Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions. Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region. Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations. Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations. Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders. Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives. Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results. Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives. Experience And Qualifications 3+ years Airports leadership experience required Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships. Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget. Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities. jobs.title: Japanese Speaking Customer Service Agent - for Netflix Japan
jobs.description: Headquarters: London URL: https://www.limitlesstech.com/ Limitless, in partnership with Netflix, is looking for Japanese-speaking freelance customer service representatives to support Netflix customers in Japan. This is a fully remote freelance opportunity for people who are confident speaking with customers, comfortable using online systems and able to work independently from home. You will provide voice-based customer support to Netflix customers, helping with account queries, service questions, technical issues and general support. You will use Netflix systems, knowledge resources and agreed support processes to provide clear, accurate and friendly resolutions. Key responsibilities include: Providing customer support in Japanese by voice Helping customers with account, service and technical queries Following Netflix support processes and quality standards Using online systems and knowledge tools to resolve customer issues Delivering a professional, friendly and efficient customer experience Completing required training, assessments and programme updates Working independently from home while staying connected with the wider support team What we are looking for: Fluent or near-native Japanese language ability Strong spoken communication skills Comfortable supporting customers by phone Confident using online systems and digital tools Reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment Ability to work independently and follow defined processes Customer service experience is useful but not essential Training: Training starts on 9th October 2026 and runs for four weeks, Monday to Friday, from 13:00 to 17:00 Japan Standard Time. Training is delivered virtually in Japanese and attendance across the fixed training schedule is required. Working hours: Once live, the current available service windows are: Monday to Friday 09:00-13:00 JST 17:00-21:00 JST Available working patterns and shifts will be confirmed during training. Earnings: You will be paid $20 USD per hour during training and the initial live period. You will then move to an On-Target Earnings model of up to $20 USD per hour, linked to agreed service and performance measures. Please note, if you achieve the contract KPIs (speed of handling and quality), you WILL get $20 - we want and need to pay you $20 as that means we are hitting our targets! Freelance arrangement: This is an independent freelance opportunity, not an employed position. You will register on the Limitless platform and complete the required online verification, assessments and programme qualification stages before joining training. Payment is made monthly, directly to your PayPal. We do not withhold any earnings for any regulatory requirement. As an independant contractor, all regulatory requirements in your region are your responsibility. We accept freelancers from most countries and regions, however, if your country or region is not 'gig-friendly' it will not appear as an option, meaning you can not onboarding. The onboarding process should take no more than 1 hour total effort before being invited to training. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/limitless-technology-japanese-speaking-customer-service-agent-for-netflix-japan

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - UHV Payors
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote, US Senior Account Executive - UHV Payors Remote (required to live in one of the following states: AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, MI, MN, NY, NC, TX, UT,VT) Qualifications: 4+ years of proven success in outbound sales and high-level account management, specifically closing net-new business. Strong experience in a Mid-Market sales motion, demonstrating the ability to navigate longer, more complex deal cycles and break into executive teams (VP to C-Suite). Exceptional sales acumen with a deep command of pipeline management. You require minimal hand-holding, ramp up quickly, and know how to independently unblock deals. Skilled in selling complex solutions, including SaaS, cash flow tools, or payments products, ideally in a startup or fintech environment. Bonus: A strong understanding of the payments ecosystem and the high-volume credit cards space is highly preferred and will give you a major edge. A track record of consistently exceeding targets with clear, quantifiable achievements (e.g., % over quota, revenue booked, average deal size). Advanced outbound thinker: You don't just execute cadences; you build highly strategic, multi-threaded outbound campaigns to crack into target accounts. A collaborative team player who proactively shares winning tactics and market feedback with peers, Product, Marketing, and Enablement. Experience with our target verticals (Wholesalers, Retail, Software, Logistics, and Construction) is a strong plus. Power user of sales tools like Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Apollo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact: Hunt and close complex business: Drive strategic outbound prospecting to identify, engage, and win ultra high-value customers with longer consideration phases. Navigate multi-stakeholder deals: Seamlessly manage the full sales cycle, engaging with buying groups at all levels—from operators up to the C-suite. Deliver advanced, tailored product demos that connect Melio's value directly to high-level business metrics like cash flow, operational efficiency, and ROI. Manage pipeline with precision: Maintain rigorous Salesforce hygiene and provide accurate forecasting to leadership. Host executive Google Meet meetings and occasionally travel for trade shows, conferences, or strategic client visits. Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly targets, while acting as a senior voice to help shape the go-to-market playbook as we scale the UHV team. About the team: The Ultra High Value (UHV) Payors team is a new, high-visibility initiative at Melio. You'll play a crucial role partnering to build on existing processes, and selling an innovative and dynamic solution poised for dramatic scale. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant and lasting contribution to the company’s growth and future success. About Melio USA: Competitive compensation packages: We strive to make each and every employee feel valued and appreciated. The annual base salary range for this position is $95,000 - $105,000 with an additional variable bonus. Medical, Dental, and Vision: We offer generous and highly competitive plans with up to 100% employer-paid coverage, FSA and HSA. 401K matching: Feel the investment of working at a high-growth company. Wellness: We take a holistic approach to wellness at Melio with a focus on providing financial, physical, emotional, social, and community support for our employees. Time Off: Time to rest and recharge is a priority for us. We offer competitive vacation time, sick days, holidays, parental leave and wedding days to allow you to take the time you need, when you need it. Food perks: Enjoy a weekly Seamless stipend. Growth and development: Lean on the diverse team to foster professional and personal growth through workshops, mentorship programs, and team building activities. Melio builds business-to-business (B2B) payment tools so small business owners can spend less time in the back office and more time on their craft. As the fastest-growing B2B payment platform in the US, Melio is working hard to find new and better ways to help small businesses succeed in the ways that work best for them. Melio's diversity, equity and inclusion efforts have always been a top priority within our team. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all of our employees encompass different strengths, experiences and backgrounds. DEI within Melio prioritizes race, gender, age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts that make up one's identity. Having a diverse team across all offices is key to our success, and inclusion is each #TeaMelio member's responsibility. Melio accepts job applications on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. If you are interested in applying for this job opportunity, please do so directly on our careers page (or if you’re here already, scroll down and apply now!). This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/melio-senior-account-executive-uhv-payors

jobs.description: Headquarters: SF or Remote (PST) About the Role Hex is one of the fastest-growing AI-native data platforms, and enterprise is our next frontier: we're expanding beyond early adopters and digital-native customers to win the largest, most established organizations in the market. We're hiring an Enterprise Sales Manager to lead and build out the western portion of our Enterprise AE team as we scale into this next phase of growth. This is a true build role: you'll shape how we hire, ramp, and coach Enterprise AEs, and play a defining role in how Hex shows up in your market, from positioning to executive relationships to partner presence. You'll coach a team through high velocity, complex, multi stakeholder sales cycles, acting as a strategic partner to your reps as they navigate competitive, high stakes deals. What you will do Recruit, hire, and ramp a growing Enterprise AE team, building a repeatable onboarding and coaching program. Coach reps through complex, multi stakeholder enterprise deals, from new pipeline generation to existing account growth, running deal reviews and call coaching that improve win rate and velocity. Establish operating rhythms (1:1s, pipeline reviews, QBRs, call reviews) and coaching frameworks that raise team performance. Partner cross functionally with RevOps, SDR, Marketing, and Product to sharpen lead quality, territory and account strategy, and sales tooling. Help define how Hex goes to market with the largest organizations in our space, shaping positioning, buyer strategy, and executive relationships in your territory. Travel as needed for QBRs, customer meetings, and team development. Who you might be You might be a fit for this role if you have: A track record managing sellers through high velocity enterprise sales, both new pipeline generation and growing existing accounts, with 3+ years managing and scaling quota carrying AE teams in B2B SaaS. Experience as a strategic deal navigator, coaching reps through complex, competitive, multi threaded deals. Prior IC closing experience in complex, technical sales cycles (trial led motions a plus), and familiarity selling AI, data, or analytics solutions Startup experience is a plus: we're looking for a creative problem solver who can build, not just operate inside a structured org already in place. A consistent track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong performers. Strong operational rigor: forecasting, pipeline management, coaching cadence, and process reinforcement. Comfort partnering across functions and influencing without authority. Located in PT or MT regions In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off. jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships & Affiliates
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote, US Senior Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships & Affiliates Location: Remote (required to live in one of the following states: AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, MI, MN, NY, NC, TX, UT,VT) Qualifications: 4+ years of sales or partnership experience , ideally in a role where you had to build a book of business from scratch. A "Hunter-Farmer" Hybrid: You are fearless when cold calling potential partners to pitch a revenue-share opportunity, but you also possess the empathy and organization to nurture those relationships into a productive community over time. Thrives in Ambiguity: You don’t need a playbook—you want to write it. You are comfortable testing new pitches, identifying new vertical targets (e.g., insurance, logistics consultants), and pivoting quickly based on what works. Creative & Scrappy: You can see the angle that others miss. You understand how to frame a value proposition not just to a user, but to a partner looking to monetize their influence. Community Builder Mindset: You understand that signing a partner is just day one. You know how to keep affiliates engaged, excited, and producing leads through constant communication and value-add interactions. Genuinely Curious about Business Models: You need to understand how our partners make money (e.g., how a Credit Card Points Consultant operates) to effectively pitch how Melio fits into their ecosystem. Proficiency in SalesForce, Outreach.io, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact: Identify & Recruit (The Hunt) Prospect and Cold Call: You will aggressively hunt for high-leverage affiliates—think Credit Card Points Consultants, Insurance Brokers who don't accept cards, or Industry-Specific Consultants. Pitch the "Business in a Box": You aren't just selling software; you are selling a revenue stream. You will convince these partners that referring their high-spend clients to Melio is a lucrative way to monetize their existing relationships through our Gross Profit revenue share model. Creative Sourcing: You will experiment with different verticals to find the "hidden gems"—partners who have trusted access to UHV companies but haven't monetized that influence yet. Onboard & Enable (The Setup) White-Glove Onboarding: Once a partner says "yes," you ensure they (and their clients) are set up for success. You will help them identify the low-hanging fruit in their book of business to get their first wins on the board quickly. Technical & Sales Enablement: Teach partners how to spot a Melio opportunity and how to pitch it to their clients. Community Management & Nurture (The Flywheel) Drive Portfolio Adoption: You will manage your book of affiliates like a community manager. Your goal is to keep them active, sending leads, and viewing Melio as a significant revenue driver for their business. Relationship Moats: Build deep, personal relationships with your partners so that Melio remains their exclusive referral of choice. Feedback Loop: Since this is a new motion, you will constantly feed insights back to growth and marketing teams. What segments provide deep opportunities for UHV? What incentives drive the most behavior? About the team: Melio is on a mission to keep small businesses in business. We simplify B2B payables and receivables so business owners—and the professionals who support them—can focus on what they do best. You will be joining the Ultra High Value team but operating as the spearhead for this specific Affiliate/Partnership motion. This is a role for a pioneer—someone who wants to look back in a year and say, "I built that channel." You will have high visibility and the autonomy to experiment with creative strategies to drive volume. About Melio USA: Competitive compensation packages: We strive to make each and every employee feel valued and appreciated. The annual base salary range for this position is $95,000-$105,000 with an additional bonus component. Medical, Dental, and Vision: We offer generous and highly competitive plans with up to 100% employer-paid coverage, FSA and HSA. 401K matching: Feel the investment of working at a high-growth company. Wellness: We take a holistic approach to wellness at Melio with a focus on providing financial, physical, emotional, social, and community support for our employees. Time Off: Time to rest and recharge is a priority for us. We offer competitive vacation time, sick days, holidays, parental leave and wedding days to allow you to take the time you need, when you need it. Food perks: Enjoy a weekly Seamless stipend. Growth and development: Lean on the diverse team to foster professional and personal growth through workshops, mentorship programs, and team building activities. Melio builds business-to-business (B2B) payment tools so small business owners can spend less time in the back office and more time on their craft. As the fastest-growing B2B payment platform in the US, Melio is working hard to find new and better ways to help small businesses succeed in the ways that work best for them. Melio's diversity, equity and inclusion efforts have always been a top priority within our team. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all of our employees encompass different strengths, experiences and backgrounds. DEI within Melio prioritizes race, gender, age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts that make up one's identity. Having a diverse team across all offices is key to our success, and inclusion is each #TeaMelio member's responsibility. Melio accepts job applications on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. If you are interested in applying for this job opportunity, please do so directly on our careers page (or if you’re here already, scroll down and apply now!). This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/melio-senior-account-executive-strategic-partnerships-affiliates

jobs.description: Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.) Commercial Data Scientist Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare. How you’ll make an impact: Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies. Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. About you: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets. Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory. Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships. Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries. Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training. Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders. Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research. Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections. Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights. The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds. We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events! Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. You will report to the Product Lead and will be located in San Francisco, CA (hybrid). jobs.title: Legal Ops
jobs.description: Headquarters: NYC or Remote (EST or CST) About the role: Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. This is a builder role. You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product. We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home. What you will do: Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack About You: 3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex. Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer You care whether people actually use what you build Nice to have: Experience at a company navigating exponential growth Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings) Has used Hex Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you. In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off. The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500. The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process. By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy . Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our team evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-legal-ops

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote - United States About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads. Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code. You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch. AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself. You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team. If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do: Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production. Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem. Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads. Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships. Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases. Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships. About You: Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch. You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase. You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need. You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design. You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes. You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce. There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it. Bonus If You: Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences. Have worked with AI models, providers, inference platforms, guardrails, or AI application tooling. Have experience with APIs, command-line tools, structured product content, or agent-facing interfaces. Have built an application or agent with Vercel’s AI SDK or AI Gateway. See the work: AI Gateway AI Gateway documentation Browse AI models AI model leaderboards Design Engineering at Vercel Compensation & Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000 - $312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote, United States About Calm Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health , offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter . Learn more at calm.com . What We Do At Calm we believe in making relaxation, better sleep, and mindfulness accessible to the entire world, and we hope you will help us achieve our mission. The Product & Design team is responsible for delivering Calm to our customers, ensuring that it is easy to use, supports their goals, and maintains a high level of quality across web, iOS, Android platforms. As a Senior Product Designer on our Consumer team, you'll shape experiences used by tens of millions of people to sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully. People often reach for Calm in their most vulnerable moments, so the craft of what we make (how it looks, moves, and feels) matters enormously. This is a builder's role in the truest sense: you'll use AI and modern prototyping tools to move from insight to interactive prototype to shipped experience, not as a shortcut on quality, but to spend less time producing and more time on the judgment and detail that make an experience great. When anyone can generate a hundred screens in an afternoon, taste and judgment are the differentiators! The heart of this role is balancing velocity and craft in service of making our users healthier and happier, and building intuitive, engaging and impactful experiences that drive acquisition, engagement and retention. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing, and set the standard for craft across iOS, Android, and web. You will be a thought leader in design, helping to establish best practices and setting the bar for exceptional product design at Calm. What You’ll Do Own end-to-end product design initiatives that cover the whole product experience (visual, interaction, motion, brand integration), to create thoughtful, high-quality user-centered mobile experiences. Prototype quickly in Figma and with AI and low-code tools like Replit, Lovable, and Claude, so you can get real, testable ideas in front of people early. Present your design work clearly and persuasively to cross-functional stakeholders (including senior leadership), give and take feedback well, anchoring your rationale to both user needs and business goals. Maintain strong attention to detail and collaboration through engineering implementation (build and QA) and post launch-iterations, to ensure high-quality execution. Use data and drive research to inform the experiences you build, and leverage performance insights to evolve your approach. Champion system-level thinking (improving how the team works and evolving Calm's design system) so the whole team works faster and smarter. Balance multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of execution. Who You Are Experienced Product Designer: 7+ years of experience in UX and UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile and web applications. AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in Figma for design, and already using AI and low-code tools (Replit, Lovable, Claude) to prototype and move fast, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't. Technical agility: Comfortable shipping small code changes without engineering support, bridging the gap between design and engineering by personally shipping copy and UI polish directly. A builder: Biased toward shipping and iterating over perfect plans. You'd rather put a working prototype in front of people than write a doc about one. Data- and research-informed: You fold both qualitative and quantitative insight into your design decisions, and you measure whether the work landed. A strong collaborator: A low-ego, trusted partner to Product, Research, and Engineering who makes the people around them better and helps sharpen how the team works. High craft standards: A strong advocate for accessibility, consistency, visual storytelling, brand integration, and motion design to create engaging user experiences, while still maintaining velocity. A clear communicator: You present your thinking persuasively to stakeholders and senior leadership, give and take feedback well, and champion an experience while staying open to being wrong. Nice to Haves Experience with conversational or AI-native UX. Experience working at multiple organizations, ideally including time at a consumer product in a fast-paced startup environment. A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to design and ship beautiful, functional, and user-friendly experiences. Comfort shipping small copy and UI changes directly in code, without engineering support. A passion for Calm's mission and a point of view on how digital products can support mental health. Minimum Requirements 7+ years in UX/UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile (and web) applications. Proven experience driving user testing and research. Strong foundation in interaction design, visual design, and usability best practices. Experience designing and shipping mobile applications at scale. Hands-on proficiency in Figma and modern AI/prototyping tools. Ability to work independently while contributing to a larger design vision and strategy. jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote, United States About Calm Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health , offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter . Learn more at calm.com . What You'll Do As a Growth Product Manager on Calm's direct-to-consumer business, you'll help more people discover, adopt, and build daily habits with Calm. You'll own the growth product strategy and roadmap, accountable for driving subscriber growth, activation, revenue per user, and retention. You'll set the priorities, design and run the experiments that test them, and partner with engineering, product design, marketing, data, and research to ship what works. Your goal is to make it effortless for users to form a lasting mindfulness habit while helping Calm reach and sustain its growth goals. As a Product Manager working on Calm’s direct-to-consumer business, you will drive measurable impact across top-of-funnel conversion, trial-to-paid transitions, user activation, and long-term retention. You will design, execute, and analyze product experiments in collaboration with engineering, design, marketing, and data science teams. Day to day, you will: Own growth strategy and roadmap: Develop and own Calm's growth product strategy and roadmap, translating company revenue, subscriber, and DAU goals into a prioritized set of bets across activation, conversion, and retention. Run a high-velocity experiment program: Form sharp hypotheses, design and ship A/B tests with engineering and data science, and read results honestly — including the ones that don't win. Remove friction from key journeys: Use quantitative and qualitative data to find where users drop off in onboarding, habit-building, and account flows, then test simpler paths through them. Ship habit mechanics: Build the features that help users plan, track, and celebrate progress, so a first session becomes a daily practice. Write PRDs that make decisions easy : Spell out the job to be done, the opportunity, success metrics, and the plan to ship and iterate — then bring engineers, designers, marketers, and leadership along as the plan changes. Who You Are A growth PM, or equivalent, who's owned the number: 4+ years in consumer product, with a track record of owning a growth metric (subscriber growth, conversion, retention) and setting the strategy to move it, across consumer mobile (iOS and Android) and web. A subscription-business operator: Fluent in the economics of consumer subscription (trial and paywall conversion, LTV, churn) and how product decisions show up in them. A rapid experimenter: Experienced in fast experiment design and analysis (A/B tests, holdouts, sequential testing), with the statistical judgment to know when a result is real and when it's noise. Data-fluent: Adept at sourcing quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize a roadmap and make feature calls, and decisive when the data won't settle it. A student of habit formation: You know what drives repeat daily usage and how to build the mechanics (streaks, reminders, progress, celebration) that turn a new user into a daily one. AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in leveraging AI tools to drive team velocity and build lasting workflows, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't. Technically agile: Comfortable discussing complexity and tradeoffs with engineers, and able to prototype your own ideas rather than wait in a queue. Exceptional at documentation and organization: You keep the experiment log, results archive, and roadmap docs in a state where anyone can find what was tested, what it showed, and what's live (so the team builds on its own learnings instead of rediscovering them.) A low-ego, persuasive partner: You present your thinking clearly in writing and in the room, to stakeholders and senior leadership alike, hold positions with conviction and update them on evidence, and make Product Design, User Acquisition, Research, and Engineering better for working with you. Nice to Haves Experience in subscription-based consumer tech (onboarding, paywalls, or retention initiatives). Familiarity with product analytics or experimentation tools (e.g., Amplitude). Experience working with or passion for the health & wellness domain. Experience in developing features that drive habit formation and lifestyle change. Minimum Requirements 4+ years of relevant experience in growth, product management, or equivalent. jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
jobs.description: Headquarters: remote URL: https://www.toptal.com/ Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team! This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs. Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest. Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success. Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team. Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics. In the first week, expect to: Onboard and integrate into Toptal. Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story. Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success. Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies. Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal. Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success. In the first month, expect to: Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios. Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator). Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts. Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives. Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers. In the first three months, expect to: Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities. Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal. Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives. Become proficient in using our SaaS tools. Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com. In the first six months, expect to: Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives. Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs. Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans. Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities. In the first year, expect to: Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list. Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR. Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients. Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal. Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries. Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important. Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement. Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business. Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative. Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies. Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts. Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures. Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks. Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-enterprise-sales-development-representative
