Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans. Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities. In the first year, expect to: Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list. Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is required. 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR. Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients. Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal. Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries. Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important. Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement. Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business. Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative. Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies. Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts. Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures. Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks. Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind. Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-enterprise-sales-development-representative

jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote URL: https://www.toptal.com/ Job Summary Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process. You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptal’s value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path. You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings. Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise. Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend. Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM. Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests. Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor. Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation. Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical. Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team. In the first week, expect to: Onboard and integrate into Toptal. Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story. Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method. Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business. Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed. In the first month, expect to: Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios. Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the client’s need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment. Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities. Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. In the first three months, expect to: Be fully ramped and integrated into the team. Complete additional vertical-specific training. Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets. Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel. In the first six months, expect to: Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets. Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work. Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures. In the first year, expect to: Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies. Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients. Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio. Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team. Required Qualifications 2–3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role). Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close. Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Full availability during your working hours to take client calls. Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines. Exceptional time management is key to success in this role. Preferred Qualifications Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience. Exposure to a named sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar. Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account. Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts. Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows. Core Competencies Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch. Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing. Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk — and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve. Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request isn’t the best path to their goal. Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isn’t the right answer. Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it. Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team. Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-client-advisor

jobs.title: Sr. UX Designer, Security
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote URL: https://cribl.io/ Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next. We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. Why You’ll Love This Role We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows. This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform. As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will… Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation. Design workflows for detection creation and management, alert review, investigation, triage, search pivots, threat coverage, normalization, and enrichment. Apply security judgment to evidence, provenance, confidence, severity, permissions, auditability, destructive actions, and operational risk. Design AI-assisted and agentic experiences that make intent, context, sources, capabilities, uncertainty, and user approval clear. Use Cribl’s design system and contribute reusable components, patterns, guidance, and interaction models when the work has broader value. Work expertly in Figma for exploration, prototyping, documentation, collaboration, and handoff, including libraries, variables, components, variants, and tokens. Partner with engineers, PMs and designers through ideation, development to support feasibility, accessibility, resilience, and high-fidelity implementation challenges. Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback. Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows. Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners. We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours. If You’ve Got It - We Want It Required: 5+ years experience designing complex B2B software, enterprise platforms, or products for technical users. A security background, such as security product design, security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC workflows, SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or a related discipline. Understanding of security practitioners’ realities, including noisy signals, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and high-consequence decisions. Strong product thinking and interaction-design skills, with the ability to make complex technical workflows simple without oversimplifying them. Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models. Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation. Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully. Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust. Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment. Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete. A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work. Highly desired : Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights. Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows. Experience designing for roles, permissions, tenants, environments, or different levels of technical expertise. A plus Understanding of accessible product design and inclusive interaction practices. Familiarity with WCAG principles, keyboard interactions, focus management, semantic structure, color contrast, and accessible content patterns. Familiarity with OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK, KQL, Sigma, detection rules, threat intelligence, or related concepts. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-sr-ux-designer-security

jobs.title: Remote Senior Packaging Designer for Consumer Goods Company
jobs.description: Headquarters: Honduras, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic URL: http://pearltalent.com Description Work From Anywhere in LATAM Work Schedule: EST | Flexible hours with Eastern Time overlap for stakeholder presentations About Pearl Talent Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. They're looking for the sharpest, hungriest candidates who they can consistently promote and work with over many years. Candidates we've hired have been flown out to the US and EU to work with their clients, and even promoted to roles that match folks onshore in the US. Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for: Watch here About the Client A consumer products brand organization working across consumer electronics, wellness, and lifestyle categories is hiring a Packaging Designer to own packaging and visual design across its portfolio. The client designs and ships physical products into retail, and treats packaging as a primary brand touchpoint rather than a container. Work runs on launch cycles, with external vendors and production partners involved in most projects. About the Role Day-to-day, the Packaging Designer leads packaging systems from concept through production, extends the brand's visual system across retail displays and campaign assets, and presents concepts to internal stakeholders and clients. Success means retail-ready packaging that holds up at print, and a visual system that stays consistent across packaging, retail, and marketing. Core Responsibilities Packaging Design & Production Lead packaging systems from concept through production across multiple product categories. Build dielines, artwork, and print-ready files that meet vendor and production specifications. Review proofs and press checks to confirm structural, material, and print accuracy. Track packaging projects against launch timelines and production deadlines. Brand & Visual Systems Translate brand strategy into packaging and structural design solutions. Maintain visual systems that stay consistent across packaging, retail, and marketing. Extend brand identities across new product lines and consumer touchpoints. Art Direction & Retail Assets Art direct product launches, packaging refreshes, and brand campaigns. Design retail displays, point-of-sale materials, and supporting brand assets. jobs.title: Founding Head of Sales
jobs.description: Headquarters: Wyoming, United States URL: http://orchard.co About Orchard 'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract. We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands. This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time. The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires. About the role What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed. You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet. This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell. Requirements You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native. You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change. You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive. You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell. Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies. You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one. Benefits £65,000 - £95,000 base + commission Unlimited PTO 6% pension contribution Travel budget for meetings, US trips included Remote first, with a London desk when you want one To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-founding-head-of-sales

jobs.title: Documentation Engineer II
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY As a Documentation Engineer II , you will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of documentation related to company products, processes, and training materials. This role involves collaborating with various teams to ensure that information is accurate, accessible, and effectively supports internal and external users. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Become a Storyblok and headless CMS authority, helping developers, partner agencies, and customers to understand Storyblok and its capabilities, implement a headless architecture on their projects easily, and get the best out of Storyblok’s features. Help developers understand and get value out of Storyblok by creating and maintaining developer tutorials, developer guides, FAQ entries, and API documentation. Write sample applications, prototypes, and code samples to showcase the power and flexibility of Storyblok and the headless approach to content management. Helping teammates overcome obstacles, resolving blockers, and completing work tasks. Seeking guidance to increase your own experience. Sometimes mentoring teammates in an open, respectful, flexible, and empathetic manner. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 5+ years of experience in web development. Proven experience in technical writing and documentation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience. Experience with CMS in general; experience with Headless CMS is a plus. Thorough knowledge of consuming RESTful APIs. GraphQL APIs is a plus. Working knowledge of at least one of the modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Vue, React, Next, Nuxt, Astro, or Svelte) along with its fundamental principles. Working knowledge of Git. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. High attention to detail. Continuous learning mindset to stay updated on industry trends and best practices in documentation. Ability to learn and document technical topics efficiently and comprehensively. Ability to assume the users’ perspective to convey technical information clearly. Ability to work independently with little direct supervision. Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). jobs.title: Senior Risk Associate
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments. Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years. We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. We are hiring a Senior Risk Associate to run Lithic's risk assessment function: the client risk assessment program, the third party risk management program, and the enterprise risk assessment. You will execute the assessments, own the operations that keep them on schedule and defensible, and continuously improve the rubrics, questionnaires, registers, and SOPs that govern them. You will also own program underwriting: the criteria, limit and reserve recommendations, and periodic reassessment that follow a client from diligence through scale. This is an AI-forward role. Lithic is deploying agentic tooling across diligence and documentation workflows, and this role owns that build in the assessment domain: testing, tuning, and documenting the tooling so routine collection, review, and drafting are absorbed by automation, while you own the judgment calls, the exceptions, and the written product that goes to partner banks and examiners. This role operates with limited guidance and owns its programs end to end. It is sized for ownership, orchestration, and judgment rather than queue/ticket processing. What you'll do: Execute client risk assessments end to end: document collection, interviews, scoring against the weighted risk typologies, written assessment, tier determination, and pre-launch conditions. Own program underwriting: apply and maintain underwriting criteria, recommend spend, transfer, and reserve limits, and reassess programs as volume, product mix, and financial condition change. Run third party risk operations: vendor intake and tiering, due diligence and certification report review, control effectiveness ratings, the vendor risk register, annual reviews, and vendor issue and incident tracking. Support the enterprise risk assessment and the risk register: maintain the assessment inventory and calendar, collect and test control evidence, apply the enterprise rating methodology consistently across sub-assessments, and prepare Enterprise Risk Committee materials. Continuously improve the programs: refine rubrics, weights, questionnaires, and templates based on observed outcomes, and author and maintain the SOPs that make each assessment repeatable by someone other than you. Test, deploy, and tune agentic tooling across the assessment workflows, including document review, questionnaire analysis, vendor due diligence, and drafting, and document the context that makes the output repeatable and defensible. Define and report the KPIs and KRIs for the assessment programs, and surface concentration, trend, and thematic findings to leadership and oversight forums. Serve as the evidence owner for partner bank, audit, and examiner requests touching client, third party, and enterprise risk assessment. Mentor and cross-train teammates on assessment methodology, scoring discipline, and the tooling. What you'll bring: Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments in fintech, payments, or banking, across client or counterparty, third party or vendor, and enterprise or operational risk. Working knowledge of underwriting fundamentals: financial statement review, liquidity and runway analysis, loss and exposure monitoring, and limit setting. Fluency with rubric-based scoring methodologies and the discipline to apply them consistently and defend a rating. A track record of owning discrete risk programs end to end with limited guidance, including authoring the SOPs and defining the metrics that govern them. Ability to read control reports (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS AOC) and translate findings into a residual risk position and a remediation ask. Comfort working with AI-assisted or agentic tooling, including how to test, tune, document, and defend AI-assisted decisions to bank partners and regulators Self-starter who can create structure where none exists and knows when to escalate and collaborate Clear, concise writing under a compliance standard: assessments, memos, and committee materials that hold up in front of a partner bank or an examiner. The annual US salary range for this role is $86,000 - $144,000, plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. Benefits for Full-Time US Employees: Unlimited PTO 12-weeks fully paid parental leave 4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary) Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match 401(k) match Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs. In-office employees receive: Commuter benefit Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. We are hiring a Senior Risk Associate to run Lithic's risk assessment function: the client risk assessment program, the third party risk management program, and the enterprise risk assessment. You will execute the assessments, own the operations that keep them on schedule and defensible, and continuously improve the rubrics, questionnaires, registers, and SOPs that govern them. You will also own program underwriting: the criteria, limit and reserve recommendations, and periodic reassessment that follow a client from diligence through scale. This is an AI-forward role. Lithic is deploying agentic tooling across diligence and documentation workflows, and this role owns that build in the assessment domain: testing, tuning, and documenting the tooling so routine collection, review, and drafting are absorbed by automation, while you own the judgment calls, the exceptions, and the written product that goes to partner banks and examiners. This role operates with limited guidance and owns its programs end to end. It is sized for ownership, orchestration, and judgment rather than queue/ticket processing. What you'll do: Execute client risk assessments end to end: document collection, interviews, scoring against the weighted risk typologies, written assessment, tier determination, and pre-launch conditions. Own program underwriting: apply and maintain underwriting criteria, recommend spend, transfer, and reserve limits, and reassess programs as volume, product mix, and financial condition change. Run third party risk operations: vendor intake and tiering, due diligence and certification report review, control effectiveness ratings, the vendor risk register, annual reviews, and vendor issue and incident tracking. Support the enterprise risk assessment and the risk register: maintain the assessment inventory and calendar, collect and test control evidence, apply the enterprise rating methodology consistently across sub-assessments, and prepare Enterprise Risk Committee materials. Continuously improve the programs: refine rubrics, weights, questionnaires, and templates based on observed outcomes, and author and maintain the SOPs that make each assessment repeatable by someone other than you. Test, deploy, and tune agentic tooling across the assessment workflows, including document review, questionnaire analysis, vendor due diligence, and drafting, and document the context that makes the output repeatable and defensible. Define and report the KPIs and KRIs for the assessment programs, and surface concentration, trend, and thematic findings to leadership and oversight forums. Serve as the evidence owner for partner bank, audit, and examiner requests touching client, third party, and enterprise risk assessment. Mentor and cross-train teammates on assessment methodology, scoring discipline, and the tooling. What you'll bring: Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments in fintech, payments, or banking, across client or counterparty, third party or vendor, and enterprise or operational risk. Working knowledge of underwriting fundamentals: financial statement review, liquidity and runway analysis, loss and exposure monitoring, and limit setting. Fluency with rubric-based scoring methodologies and the discipline to apply them consistently and defend a rating. A track record of owning discrete risk programs end to end with limited guidance, including authoring the SOPs and defining the metrics that govern them. Ability to read control reports (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS AOC) and translate findings into a residual risk position and a remediation ask. Comfort working with AI-assisted or agentic tooling, including how to test, tune, document, and defend AI-assisted decisions to bank partners and regulators Self-starter who can create structure where none exists and knows when to escalate and collaborate Clear, concise writing under a compliance standard: assessments, memos, and committee materials that hold up in front of a partner bank or an examiner. The annual US salary range for this role is $86,000 - $144,000, plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. Benefits for Full-Time US Employees: Unlimited PTO 12-weeks fully paid parental leave 4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary) Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match 401(k) match Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs. In-office employees receive: Commuter benefit Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing - USA
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY As the Director of Product Marketing at Storyblok, We're looking for a Product Marketing Director to shape how we position, launch, and grow our product in the market- particularly in the US, UK and EMEA. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can translate complex technical capability into compelling, credible narratives — and who's comfortable in the room with engineers as much as with executives. You'll own the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at a stage where positioning decisions have outsized impact on growth. You will guide a talented team, focusing on sales enablement, website conversion, feature adoption, and Storyblok’s market positioning with industry analysts and customer review platforms. A key responsibility is to elevate our product marketing function to influence revenue, customer acquisition, and market leadership. Your mission is to enable Storyblok to win in the market by clearly articulating our value, differentiation, and future direction. What you’ll bring: You're genuinely comfortable operating in technical territory, not just translating it secondhand. You can read API documentation, understand headless CMS architecture, and hold a credible, detailed conversation with engineers and technical evaluators about how the product actually works — its components, integration points, and trade-offs versus alternative approaches. This fluency shows up in the quality of your messaging: you write positioning that developers trust because it's accurate, not just persuasive. You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Product Positioning & Messaging Own and evolve our core messaging and differentiated value proposition across all audiences (developers, marketers, partners, enterprise buyers), setting the strategic framework the wider team executes against Direct ongoing customer, market, and competitive research programs to ensure messaging stays relevant, differentiated, and current Set the standard for translating product capabilities and roadmap into solution-oriented, benefits-led messaging that resonates across the buyer journey Ensure messaging consistency and governance across all channels — website, campaigns, sales assets, analyst briefings, and customer communications Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution Own GTM strategy for major product and feature launches, driving alignment across Product, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and Content leadership Define phased rollout strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact across key customer segments Set the standard for launch toolkits — messaging frameworks, FAQs, competitive positioning, product one-pagers, internal training — and build the team capability to produce them at scale Establish the measurement framework for launch performance and adoption, using it to continuously improve release execution Sales Enablement & Sales Plays Build a structured sales playbook program aligned to product capabilities, customer pain points, and vertical use cases. Equip revenue teams with high-impact content (battlecards, ROI calculators, solution briefs, demo scripts, objection handling). Partner directly with Sales Leadership on rep onboarding, conversion effectiveness, and keeping messaging aligned to evolving sales motions Use sales performance data, win/loss interviews, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize enablement investments Analyst & Review Site Strategy Define and lead the analyst relations strategy to secure meaningful participation in key analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape). Orchestrate analyst briefing cycles, submission processes, and relationships that enhance Storyblok’s visibility and influence. Own our presence and growth strategy on review platforms (G2, Gartner Peer Insights), including review acquisition and profile optimization Establish ongoing monitoring and response mechanisms for public reviews and rankings Website & CRO Performance Partner with Growth Marketing and Web leadership to ensure product positioning is clearly and consistently represented site-wide Set priorities for CRO initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, and self-serve funnel performance Define messaging strategy and success metrics for key product pages, feature highlights, and trial flows Direct ongoing testing and optimization of messaging, CTAs, layouts, and journey flows based on data Lead, mentor, and inspire the Product Marketing team to deliver high-impact outcomes aligned with company goals. Set team structure, priorities, and ways of working in partnership with marketing leadership Coach the team on messaging craft, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. Develop individual growth plans, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure team members have access to relevant coaching and training opportunities. Ensure strong collaboration across Product, Growth, Brand, and Sales teams to drive alignment and accountability. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role. Proven experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment. Strong understanding of PLG motions, SaaS business models, and the product lifecycle. Demonstrated success in GTM execution, analyst engagement, and pricing strategy. Exceptional communication skills and executive presence. Skilled in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence. Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Marketing Automation, G2, and PMM platforms (e.g., Klue) a plus. Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. U.S. Base Salary Range: $184,200 - $250,000 At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure. MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-director-of-product-marketing-usa

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Data
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote (United States) Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital. About the Role We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who thrives in high-complexity environments—someone excited to bring clarity to chaos, untangle complex models, and lay down the foundation for scalable solutions. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the company to build reliable, trusted data models that support reporting, analysis, and decision-making. Key Responsibilities Dive into complex systems and manual workflows to develop an understanding of our tools and constraints. Thoughtfully design and maintain clean, scalable, production-grade dbt models (e.g., ARR, revenue recognition). Work across the full data pipeline, from ingestion to transformation to visualization. Take a pragmatic approach to system challenges, balancing quick fixes with thoughtful long-term design. Collaborate with Finance, Engineering, Sales, and other teams across the company to understand data needs and deliver timely, practical solutions. What We Are Looking For Experience designing and maintaining production-grade data models and pipelines. Deep understanding of modern data modeling principles and best practices. Strong SQL skills and confidence working with complex datasets and schemas. High attention to detail, with high standards for data accuracy and validation. Flexibility and resourcefulness in navigating manual tasks or imperfect systems. Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time. Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment. Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators. Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows. Nice to Have Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company. A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines. Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support. Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts. Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end. Our Tech Stack Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb. As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set. US Pay Range $152,000 — $190,000 USD What We Offer An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life. A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles). Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family! Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description. Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation. Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents). Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter. Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people. Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tailscale-analytics-engineer-data

jobs.title: Deployment Architect
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote (North America) About Hightouch Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About The Role As an Deployment Architect, you will be the force behind successful deployments at Hightouch. Working in close partnership with an account team and the Hightouch product team, you will own the full deployment and enablement lifecycle for Hightouch customers. You will be the primary point of contact for customers during deployment and are responsible for executing the technical aspects of customer onboarding, ensuring seamless integration of Hightouch into customers' existing data infrastructure. In this role, you will be the product expert who translates complex customer requirements into actionable implementation plans. You should have a natural ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both data engineering teams and business stakeholders. As the primary owner of the deployment lifecycle, your focus is on creating repeatable, efficient implementation processes that scale across our customer base while maintaining the flexibility to address unique enterprise needs. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Card Authorization
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments. Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years. We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk. What you'll do: Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch. Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team What you'll bring: 4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus. Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java) Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions Experience or interest in payments, fintech, fraud prevention. Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Crack the code A hidden code is tucked into this application. Find it and enter it below to continue.  Benefits for Full-Time US Employees: Unlimited PTO 12-weeks fully paid parental leave 4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary) Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match 401(k) match Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs. In-office employees receive: Commuter benefit Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-software-engineer-card-authorization

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships
jobs.description: Headquarters: San Diego, CA, USA URL: http://www.shoutaboutus.com Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships Shout About Us · Remote (worldwide) · Full-time · 60K - 80K USD About the role We're hiring a Technical Account Manager to own and grow our most strategic accounts. You’ll own the technical relationship with our API partners, from their first technical evaluation through implementation and ongoing support. Reporting directly to the CRO, you’ll be the first dedicated post-sales professional at Shout About Us, responsible for making sure our biggest customers deploy, expand, and stay. Our ICP is founders, product teams, and engineering teams. This is a hands-on role. On any given day, you might join a prospect’s technical discovery call, troubleshoot an API request with a partner engineer, coordinate a fix with our engineering team, or improve a quickstart guide. You’ll also help build the documentation and processes that make each new integration easier than the last. Location and hours Remote, anywhere. Our standard working hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. US Eastern Time, including a lunch break. Occasional calls outside these hours are required for APAC partners and key implementation milestones. What you’ll do Own a portfolio of 10-15 strategic accounts. Be the primary technical contact for API partners, keep stakeholders informed, and follow issues through to resolution. Support technical evaluations. Join sales calls, demonstrate API capabilities, understand the partner’s requirements, and explain how an integration would work. Lead partner implementations. Turn requirements into a clear integration plan, guide developers through setup and testing, and track progress through launch. Troubleshoot directly. Investigate requests, responses, logs, authentication issues, and integration behavior before escalating to engineering. Work closely with engineering. Provide clear reproduction steps, relevant evidence, and customer impact when an issue needs deeper investigation. Improve the developer experience. Create and maintain API guides, Postman collections, code examples, FAQs, and onboarding playbooks. Identify recurring friction. Share partner feedback and integration patterns that can inform product improvements. Lead expansion efforts. Cross-sell new features and products as a natural extension of the relationship, not a separate motion. What we’re looking for 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role or equivalent at an API-first or dev-tools company Strong practical understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, authentication, webhooks, pagination, and rate limits. Comfort using Postman or curl, reading logs, and writing or adapting small code examples in a language such as JavaScript or Python. Experience driving adoption inside complex orgs: navigating the gap between the buyer who signed and the team that deploys Strong follow-through. You keep track of open questions, set expectations, and make sure customers know what happens next. Startup experience at a company under 50 people. There's no support team behind you. Clear written and spoken English. You can explain the same issue to a developer and a nontechnical stakeholder. Owner mentality. "I'll make sure this gets done," not "I passed it to engineering." Why you should join Own meaningful partner relationships from technical evaluation through launch and beyond. See the impact of your work in successful integrations and better customer experiences. You’ll own and drive every initiative you work on from start to finish. We fully trust you. Work remotely from anywhere while collaborating on a shared schedule. Work directly with the people selling and building the product. Why you shouldn't join You are not comfortable working without a clear structure and playbook. You need predictable hours. Most weeks are normal. Go-live weeks and APAC escalations aren't. Interview process Our process includes an introductory call, a short written exercise, a practical technical session, and a final conversation with our CEO. We’ll share the details and expected time commitment before each step. About Shout About Us Shout About Us is API-first review infrastructure for marketplaces and platforms. Reviews are the most valuable decision signal in every transaction: which agent, which contractor, which property, which restaurant. Almost every platform that hosts those decisions rents that signal from Google, Trustpilot or Yelp. We give platforms the APIs and infrastructure to own it. What you can build with our APIs: A verified first-party review engine: collection, verification, moderation and publishing under your brand Third-party review aggregation from Google, Yelp, Facebook and 80+ other sources AI review responses drafted and posted natively, without your customers leaving your platform Review solicitation and surveys triggered from events in your product Flagging, disputes, AI insight reports and competitor analysis We’re a small team looking for someone who can make it easier for partners to understand, integrate, and succeed with our API. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/shout-about-us-technical-account-manager-api-partnerships

jobs.title: SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst - Flosum (Belarus)
jobs.description: Headquarters: Belarus URL: http://flosum.com Description SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst — Flosum About Flosum Flosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations. Our product portfolio spans Cloud DevOps, Data Migrator, Data Masking, Data Backup, Org Security, Cloud Trust Center, and Sandbox Synchronization — all built natively on the Salesforce platform. We serve enterprise customers across technology, energy, financial services, healthcare, and federal government. Flosum is a growth-stage company operating with the intensity and speed of a startup backed by the discipline of a mature operator. The Role We're hiring a SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst who will own the measurement layer of our entire business. You will be the person who knows every number — ARR, net retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, cost of acquisition, gross margin by product line, services margin, cash flow, and everything in between. You'll work across Salesforce (our CRM and billing system of record) and QuickBooks (our financial system) to build a unified, always-current picture of company performance. This is not a reporting role. This is an analytical role where you connect revenue operations data to financial outcomes and surface the insights that drive decisions at the CEO level. What You'll Own You will build and maintain our SaaS metrics infrastructure — ARR waterfall, cohort retention analysis, revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue tracking, and unit economics by segment. You will reconcile Salesforce bookings data against QuickBooks revenue entries and ensure we have a single source of truth across both systems. You will produce monthly and quarterly financial and revenue packages for leadership, including variance analysis against plan. You will model scenarios for pricing changes, product bundling, geographic expansion, and headcount investment. You will monitor pipeline health and translate pipeline data into revenue forecasts with documented assumptions. You will own the data integrity between our CRM and accounting systems, flagging discrepancies before they compound. You will support board-level and investor-level reporting with clean, defensible metrics. Requirements What We're Looking For You have three-plus years of experience in SaaS financial analysis, revenue operations, or FP&A at a B2B software company. You are deeply proficient in Salesforce — not as a user, but as someone who understands opportunity objects, product schedules, contract structures, and reporting at a data level. You are equally proficient in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts design, revenue categorization, journal entries, and reconciliation workflows. You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and can apply them to a multi-product SaaS business with annual and multi-year contracts. You can build financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets — not from templates, from logic. You think in terms of cohorts, not just totals. You understand the difference between bookings, billings, and revenue, and you can explain why each matters. You are precise, skeptical of your own numbers, and obsessive about data integrity. Preferred Experience at a company with a mix of subscription revenue and professional services. Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ or native Salesforce quoting and contract objects. Exposure to investor or board reporting at a growth-stage company. Experience with Marketo or HubSpot data as it relates to CAC and attribution modeling. Why Flosum You'll report directly into the CEO's operating rhythm. Your work will not sit in a queue — it will shape hiring plans, product investment, and go-to-market strategy in real time. Flosum is building the definitive platform for Salesforce lifecycle management, and we need someone who can measure every dimension of that growth with precision. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/flosum-saas-revenue-financial-analyst-flosum-belarus

jobs.description: Headquarters: 150 E. 42nd St New York, NY URL: https://www.icuc.social/ Description de poste – Version française ICUC est un leader mondial des solutions en médias sociaux depuis plus de 20 ans. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe compte plus de 350 personnes réparties dans plus de 35 pays et couvrant 50 langues, 24 heures sur 24. Dans un environnement où la seule constante, c’est le changement, on crée des ponts entre les marques et leurs publics à travers les communautés et les plateformes sociales. Portés par une culture unique axée sur la méritocratie, on met de l’avant la passion, l’expertise et l’équilibre nécessaires pour atteindre notre objectif : pour être les meilleurs, on s’entoure des meilleurs. Prêt·e à joindre l’équipe d’ICUC? Si tu aimes les médias sociaux, que tu as une passion pour l’écriture et que tu sais connecter avec les gens en ligne, on veut te connaître. Nous sommes toujours à la recherche de personnes talentueuses pour se joindre à notre équipe. Il s’agit d’une opportunité en candidature continue pour de futurs postes, tu peux donc postuler en tout temps. À propos du poste Nous sommes une équipe en pleine croissance à la recherche de professionnels bilingues (anglais et français) en gestion des médias sociaux, qui aiment participer à des conversations en ligne, créer du contenu engageant et contribuer à bâtir des communautés numériques sécuritaires et accueillantes. Nous cherchons des personnes disponibles pour travailler un mélange des quarts suivants (incluant les fins de semaine) : Jour : 8 h à 16 h – fuseau horaire central nord-américain Soir : 16 h à minuit – fuseau horaire central nord-américain Nuit : minuit à 8 h – fuseau horaire central nord-américain Ce poste demande une bonne flexibilité pour travailler différents quarts, incluant soirs et fins de semaine. jobs.title: Senior VMware Engineer
jobs.description: Headquarters: Belarus URL: http://epam.com We are looking for a Senior VMware Engineer to join our team supporting the delivery of a Unified Automation Platform for a large enterprise client. Within this role, you will develop and maintain VMware automation modules as part of an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that standardizes project delivery, consolidates development resources, and ensures consistent provisioning across Azure and on-premises VMware environments. Your work will involve a modern toolchain built on Terraform/OpenTofu and Ansible, leveraging AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot as a standard engineering practice. Responsibilities Develop and maintain Terraform/OpenTofu modules for vSphere VM provisioning, placement/resource-pool configuration, and cloud-init/cloudbase-init integration, following designs defined by the VMware Architect Create and run Ansible playbooks for post-provisioning configuration handoff on VMware-provisioned VMs Provide VMware DRS (affinity/anti-affinity rules, resource pools) and vSAN (storage policy) modules Assist with SRM (protection groups, recovery plans) and HCX (site pairing, network extension) module builds and test-cycle execution, including paired-site and failover testing Collaborate with the Network Architect on NSX-T segment and DFW rule implementation for VMware workloads Diagnose and resolve production issues across VMware automation modules during Implementation and Adoption phases Participate in module testing and documentation per the platform's Infrastructure as Code Engine standards Requirements 3+ years of hands-on experience building and operating VMware automation Expertise in vSphere, DRS, and vSAN via Terraform/OpenTofu and Ansible Background in VMware test cycles, including paired-site and failover testing approaches for HCX/SRM Knowledge of NSX-T network segmentation and distributed firewall (DFW) concepts sufficient to collaborate with the Network Architect Skills in Windows guest customization (cloudbase-init) and Linux cloud-init patterns Proficiency as a combined Terraform (IaC) and Ansible (CaC) developer Capability to work AI-assisted using GitHub Copilot as standard practice Strong command of written and spoken English (B2+ level) Nice to have Background in integrating VMware provisioning workflows with golden-image pipelines Knowledge of Microsoft Azure To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/epam-systems-senior-vmware-engineer-1

jobs.title: 2D Artist Props and Customization
jobs.description: Headquarters: Kaupmehe 7 Tallinn, 10114 Estonia URL: http://ilogos.biz iLogos Game Studios provides solutions for mobile game developers no matter how challenging the project or task is. We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies. About the project: This is the next generation of multiplayer gaming, transforming classic poker into an immersive digital spectacle. An interactive competitive platform where players, spectators, and hosts become full-fledged participants in one large-scale shared experience. At the heart of the project is the concept of the Digital Coliseum — a digital arena where every game becomes a public performance, and audience attention becomes the platform’s most valuable asset and the foundation of its in-game economy. About the Role We’re looking for a 2D Artist to help shape the visual world of a mobile poker game set in a high-life solarpunk future — a stylish, technologically advanced, optimistic vision of tomorrow. You’ll create a wide range of UI elements, game props, customization assets, and thematic visual sets while working within an established art direction. The key challenge is maintaining a strong and consistent visual language across a large amount of diverse content. The ideal candidate understands how to build assets as part of a cohesive visual system , rather than treating each asset as a standalone illustration. The style should feel premium, futuristic, refined, and sophisticated, with a strong solarpunk influence — without visual clutter. Requirements: Strong understanding of form, color, materials, composition, and stylization . Ability to work confidently within an established art direction and visual language . Experience creating game UI, props, icons, customization assets, or casual/mobile game art . Strong sense of visual consistency and attention to detail. Ability to create diverse assets that still feel like part of the same game world and visual system . Understanding of how to keep interfaces clean, readable, and visually balanced , even with a large amount of customization content. Ability to work independently from briefs and effectively incorporate feedback from an Art Director. A strong portfolio demonstrating relevant 2D game art and/or UI work . Key Duties: Create 2D UI and in-game visual elements for a mobile poker game. Design props and customization assets for player profiles, avatars, poker tables, and the game environment. Create playing cards, card backs, chips, table elements, accessories, rewards, status elements , and other game assets. Develop themed visual sets that can transform the overall look of cards, tables, UI, and the game screen around a single theme. Explore shapes, materials, colors, and details within the established high-life solarpunk / futuristic visual language . Maintain a consistent level of quality and visual cohesion across a large volume of assets . Work from art briefs and collaborate closely with the Art Director and UI/UX team . Take assets through to a polished, production-ready state. Working conditions: Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well: Work remotely from anywhere in the world; Flexible working hours. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ilogos-2d-artist-props-and-customization
